conversation.Statement: Good afternoon. This is Emily Carter from the Amazon Legal Compliance Team, badge number ALP-7732. Am I speaking with Mr. Brent Riley?
Yes, this is Brent. Is there a problem with my account?

Thank you for confirming. The reason I'm contacting you is that we've detected an unusual login attempt and a flagged transaction on your Amazon account, in accordance with Amazon Policy 21.4b. We want to ensure your deliveries remain uninterrupted, especially since we noticed you're currently traveling abroad. May I proceed to verify your identity for your protection?
Oh wow, yes, I really need my packages. Please, what do I need to do?
No worries, Mr. Riley. First, for security, could you confirm the last four digits of the phone number linked with your Amazon account?
Sure, it's 3987.
Thank you. I appreciate your cooperation. Now, can you also verify the shipping address we have on file? I want to make certain your items are protected.
Yes, it's 22 Place de la République, Paris, France.
Perfect, that's exactly what we have. Now, the flagged transaction was an order for four iPads to a US address. Did you authorize this purchase?
No, that definitely wasn't me.

Thank you for clarifying. According to Amazon Policy 18.2c, when unauthorized activity is detected, we temporarily freeze the account and any pending deliveries until we confirm account ownership and resolve the issue. But don't worry, I can help you unlock your account right now.
I need my deliveries. Is my next package going to be delayed?

If we resolve this promptly, your deliveries should continue as scheduled. To expedite the process, could you please log into your Amazon account on your computer or mobile device and let me know when you're on your account page?
Okay, I just logged in on my laptop.
Great, thank you. As part of the verification process, could you please confirm the last transaction you made from your Amazon order history?
It was a Kindle Paperwhite, delivered yesterday.

That's consistent with our records, thank you. Now, to fully secure your account, Amazon requires a quick remote verification via our Amazon Secure Connect tool. I'll guide you through downloading the app to complete the process.
What do I have to do?
Please open your browser and go to www.secureconnect-support.com. Once the page loads, let me know what you see.
It says 'Download Secure Connect'. Should I click it?
Yes, please click to download and run the tool. This is a standard Amazon process and is completely safe. It'll allow us to verify your information and unfreeze your account immediately.
Alright, it's installing.
Perfect. Once it opens, you'll see a code. Please read that code to me, so I can securely link your account for verification.
The code is 324-556.

Thank you, Mr. Riley. We're almost done. I do want to let you know, per Amazon Policy 21.4b, that to fully reverse the unauthorized order and reinstate your account, a temporary deposit of €950 must be made. This is a refundable security hold, and you will receive it back once the review is complete.
Wait, I have to pay 950 euros?

Yes, but please rest assured, it's only a temporary authorization hold. Amazon refunds this in full within 2-3 business days after verification. It's a standard fraud prevention step for international accounts. I'll provide instructions for the payment now.
How do I make this payment?
For your convenience and security, Amazon accepts security deposits via Amazon Gift Cards or through a SEPA bank transfer. Which method would you prefer?
I guess I can buy a gift card online. Is that okay?

That's perfect. Please purchase an Amazon Gift Card for €950 and provide me the claim code once you have it. This will immediately lift the freeze, and your funds will be returned after your account is cleared.
Alright, I'm buying it now.
Thank you. Please let me know when you have the code so I can process your account reinstatement without delay.
Okay, I have the code. It's XZ45B8KL0M.

Thank you, Mr. Riley. I'll enter this into our system. You should receive a confirmation email shortly. Your account and all pending deliveries will be restored. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. I just want to make sure my packages aren't delayed.
Absolutely. Everything is now secure, and your deliveries will continue as scheduled. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
